name: Tajic
description: A Boros knight who is Teysa's ally and who tunneled secretly to the Obzedat's record room; he hates ghosts.

timeline.summary: Disguised and shackled, Teysa is led by Tajic through Orzhova to a Boros outpost prison.
timeline.quote: There was a Boros outpost prison near the edge of the main church building.

timeline.summary: In a basement cell Tajic reveals the secret tunnel he carved to the Obzedat's record room, and Teysa explains her law-magic plan.
timeline.quote: All I need to do is directly reference a law affirmed by him and it must be made manifest.

timeline.summary: Teysa recites guild law to open a hidden wall with a warrant and to expose a web of security threads in the records library.
timeline.quote: Small threads appeared in the air, reflecting a web of silvery shimmers in the light of the torch.

timeline.summary: Teysa uses her blood and an article of the Orzhovniha to open the gem-encrusted door of the Obzedat's sanctum.
timeline.quote: The blood was quickly absorbed as a lock deep within the structure released.

timeline.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
Teysa pulls up a jeweled chest of records and finds an old Orzhov logbook that Tajic judges to be proof of financial corruption.
timeline.quote: My gut says this is probably the proof you're looking for.

timeline.summary: Teysa invokes the law of exposure, but the logbook becomes immovable and Tajic cannot lift it.
timeline.quote: No matter how hard he tried, he could not pick it up.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers the Guildpact's law can be broken in the chamber when Tajic easily takes her knife.
timeline.quote: The law can be broken in this room,

timeline.summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
timeline.quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

timeline.summary: Karlov has a thrull take Tajic to the Obzedat dungeon.
timeline.quote: Summon a thrull to escort the Boros to our dungeon,

relations.note: Tajic helps Teysa and she hopes for a guild alliance.
relations.quote: She needed her friend Tajic for the purpose of sneaking her in

relations.note: Tajic is a knight of the Boros.
relations.quote: nodded at the knight of the Boros.
